paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score across multiple datasets for different MADLLM model configurations. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset,” lists the categories “SMD,” “PSM,” “SWaT,” “SMAP,” “MSL,” and “WADI” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, employs a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 10. For each dataset, there are four bars representing different MADLLM model variations; “MADLLM” (green), “MADLLM w/o prompt pool” (blue), “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” (purple), and “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” (brown). Within each dataset, the bars display different heights: in “SMD”, the green bar reaches approximately 96, while the brown bar reaches around 88; in “PSM”, values are approximately 96 for the green bar, and 92 for the brown bar; for “SWaT,” the green bar reaches roughly 94 and the brown bar approximately 85; in “SMAP,” the green bar measures around 80, while the brown bar reaches approximately 67; for “MSL”, the green bar reaches approximately 92 and the brown bar measures roughly 75; finally, in “WADI”, the green bar attains approximately 75, and the brown bar extends to around 68. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each dataset, and no bars are visually emphasized.
